feature_obligations.summary: Freeze exact installed versions, source digests and current evidence.
Depends P0: authenticated conversation identity and exclusive writer; retain P1a-P1h creation, rejection, expiry, release and recovery work.
Depends P1a-P1d,P0: prove supported Codex Host assertion and exclusive-writer source, or label the stock version unsupported.
Depends P1a-P1b,P1f,D0a,D0b.4: bind the single local DSH Host, native creation, graph, workspace and writer before publication.
Depends P0: per-harness method, event, approval, cancel, queue, streaming, terminal and recovery conformance matrix.
Depends P0: real authenticated Codex desktop New Chat launch and ARE gateway response proof; direct shim tests are insufficient.
Depends P0: retain the separate task-API ingress result; it is not desktop New Chat or ARE mediation proof.
Depends P0: pinned DSH Web controller seam and active alternate Agent-ingress inventory.
Depends D0a: private pinned pre-inbox admission patch, closed plugin profile and native writer-lock proof; retain D0b.4a-D0b.4d.
Depends P1,P2: owned objective, route, full parent plan, requirement continuity and writer checkpoint before first dispatch; advancement and honest read projection.
Depends P1,P2,P3,C0: an ARE-owned Codex desktop first turn rendered by the same app; no alternate writer or unverified approval claim.
Depends P1,P1g,P2,P3,D0a,D0b: real DSH Web admit/dispatch/terminal chain, with all reachable Agent bypasses mediated or disabled.
Alternative; depends P1,P2,P3: separately named DSH/ACP client and reviewed version/license, never a substitute Web-control claim.
Depends P3,C1: Codex delivery, bidirectional approval/input, interrupt, restart and uncertain-outcome reconciliation.
Depends P3,D1: same native DSH journal, cursor, generation and request keys through queue/edit/steer/cancel, crash and exclusive-writer handover.
Alternative; depends P3,A1: ACP load/resume/close and event/permission recovery with one native writer.
Depends P3 and an owned client proof: trusted correction attribution, completed answered episodes, Reasoning State and candidate Evolution projection.
Depends a recovered owned client and F1: qualify each named client/backend/OS independently; empty, active, interrupted, restart and unavailable states.
Optional; after read-only product work: verify exact tool/effect mediation and rollback per backend and OS; retain security for the end.
Optional; depends R1,E0: effect-enabled qualification only after complete tool, sandbox and release boundaries are proved.
Operational; depends R1 and owner decision: explicit packaging/configuration, installed acceptance, limits and rollback; never automatic default-on.
Optional; depends C2 and separate host release proof: one exact existing Codex chat handover with watermark, no overlapping writer and safe reverse transfer.
Optional; depends O1 and website scope/owner decision: bounded authenticated website entry/status and end-to-end integration.
Read-only Linux/Windows Overview: quiet movable orb opens a useful lazy dashboard; source, freshness, unavailable and recovery states stay distinct.
Read-only Adapters: show connected/running adapters, actual selected path, observation scope and unsupported control claims separately.
Read-only Threads: active task/frontier, parent scope, preparations, actual model/terminal state and rejected interpretations; no hidden reasoning text.
Read-only Decisions: explain linked bounded decision evidence and source limits, without granting authority or exposing private content.
Read-only Evolution: show engine/cycles, candidate feedback and evidence with correct owned-thread/episode attribution; no automatic activation.
Read-only Evidence/Diagnostics: bounded linked evidence, source loss, failures and recovery guidance; diagnostics never imply completion.
Appearance: movable reskinnable Companion, keyboard/non-drag recovery, local preferences only; qualify beauty, accessibility and low resources on both OSes.

unresolved_decisions.question: How does a trusted Host advance or replace a retained plan with a checked predecessor and without treating declared status as completion?
Which supported installed Codex desktop assertion and writer boundary can qualify stock New Chat, versus a separately named ARE-owned client?
Which explicitly configured bounded provider resolves unlabeled transitions and accounted requirement changes without implicit model calls?
How should the Companion distinguish retained plan/interpretation/preflight from rejected admission and actual model entry?
What native owned-input and completed-answer boundary permits trusted Host-local corrections to feed candidate Evolution?
What exact Windows/Linux installed lifecycle, resource/freshness budgets, accessibility and visual acceptance define the first product?
Who selects and authorizes optional effects, deployment, existing-chat handover and website scope after read-only product qualification?
